about: Every interval where each sample query is true, labelled by eye from one-frame-per-second contact sheets of the six sample videos (so boundaries are good to about half a second). 'intervals' must be found; 'acceptable' intervals are near enough that returning them is neither a hit nor a false positive; 'answers' are the accepted readings for text queries. Labelled once, before measuring any change, and not to be edited to fit results.
